💡 clip-finder | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling users to quickly find specific information within YouTube videos by searching their transcripts semantically and jumping directly to the relevant timestamp.
✨ Key Features: • Semantic transcript search with timestamped YouTube links • Channel, playlist, and single-video indexing • Smart skip for already-indexed videos • Local BYOK support via browser storage
📖 Summary: SearchTube is an AI-powered tool for semantic search of YouTube video transcripts. It allows users to index entire channels, playlists, or individual videos and then search through their content using natural language queries. The results provide exact timestamp links to the relevant moments in the videos.
